application_process: Self-register on serviceonline.gov.in Farmer Corner or visit nearest CSC / Agriculture Department office.
financial_benefit: ₹6,000 / year Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
rag_clauses: Clause 1.1: Financial benefit of Rs 6000 per annum payable in three equal four-monthly installments of Rs 2000 each.
Clause 2.3: Mandatory land record validation (RoR/Bhulekh) and Aadhaar e-KYC authentication.
summary: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of small and marginal farmer families.
target_beneficiary: All landholding farmer families across India

application_process: Biometric registration at nearest CSC center followed by Gram Panchayat verification on pmvishwakarma.gov.in.
financial_benefit: ₹15,000 Free Toolkit Grant + ₹3 Lakhs Loan at 5% Interest + ₹500/day Stipend
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
rag_clauses: Clause 3.1: Covers 18 traditional trades including Carpenter, Blacksmith, Potter, Sculptor, Cobbler, Mason, Weaver, Barber, Tailor.
Clause 5.2: Collateral-free enterprise credit of Rs. 1 Lakh (Tranche 1) and Rs. 2 Lakhs (Tranche 2) with 8% interest subvention by GoI.
summary: Holistic support for artisans including PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID, ₹500/day stipend during 5-15 days skill training, ₹15,000 modern toolkit voucher, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3 Lakhs at 5% concessional interest.
target_beneficiary: Traditional artisans and craftspersons across 18 family-based trades

application_process: Apply online at serviceonline.gov.in or visit nearest Banking Correspondent / CSC.
financial_benefit: ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 Working Capital Loan + 7% Interest Subsidy + ₹1200 UPI Cashback
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
rag_clauses: Clause 4.1: Initial collateral-free loan of Rs 10,000 repayable in 12 monthly installments. Timely repayment unlocks enhanced credit of Rs 20,000 and Rs 50,000.
Clause 6.3: Interest subsidy @7% per annum credited directly into vendor's bank account on quarterly basis.
required_documents: Vending Certificate / ID or ULB Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
summary: Special micro-credit facility providing working capital collateral-free loans of ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy and up to ₹1,200/yr cashback on digital UPI transactions.
target_beneficiary: Urban street vendors, hawkers, thela walas, and informal sellers

application_process: Register on pmsuryaghar.gov.in with Consumer ID, choose registered vendor, get net meter installed, and receive DBT subsidy.
financial_benefit: Up to ₹78,000 Direct Capital Subsidy + 300 Units Free Power / Month
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
rag_clauses: Clause 2.1: Central financial assistance of Rs 30,000/kW up to 2 kW capacity and Rs 18,000 for additional kW up to 3 kW (Max subsidy Rs 78,000).
Clause 5.1: Concessional collateral-free bank loans available at ~7% interest for remaining consumer share.
summary: Direct capital subsidy of ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, and ₹78,000 for 3 kW+ rooftop solar systems, providing up to 300 units of free monthly electricity and zero electricity bills.
target_beneficiary: Residential households across India seeking free rooftop solar power

application_process: Check eligibility on beneficiary.nha.gov.in, complete e-KYC, and download Ayushman Card instantly.
financial_benefit: ₹5,00,000 / year Cashless Hospitalization Treatment Cover
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
name: Ayushman Bharat - PM Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
rag_clauses: Clause 1.1: Health assurance of Rs 5 Lakhs per family per year covering secondary and tertiary medical treatments.
Clause 4.3: Free universal Rs 5 Lakh health cover extended to all senior citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of income.
summary: World's largest public health assurance scheme providing ₹5,00,000 cashless hospitalization treatment cover per family per year across 29,000+ empanelled public and private hospitals nationwide.
target_beneficiary: Low-income families, unorganized workers, and universal coverage for all seniors aged 70+

application_process: Apply online at kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal. District Task Force Committee approves and sanctions bank loan.
financial_benefit: Up to ₹17.5 Lakhs Subsidy (35% Margin Money Grant on Bank Loan)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
rag_clauses: Clause 7.3: Subsidy rate in Rural areas is 25% for General and 35% for Special categories (SC/ST/OBC/Women/Minorities). In Urban areas, it is 15% and 25%.
Clause 4.2: 8th standard pass minimum qualification for projects above Rs 10 Lakhs in manufacturing or Rs 5 Lakhs in services.
summary: Credit-linked subsidy scheme offering 15% to 35% government capital subsidy (Margin Money grant) for setting up new micro-enterprises in manufacturing (up to ₹50 Lakhs) and service sectors (up to ₹20 Lakhs).
target_beneficiary: Aspiring entrepreneurs, micro-enterprises, rural youth, women, SC/ST, and artisans

application_process: Apply online via udyamimitra.in or visit any scheduled commercial bank, RRB, MFI, or NBFC branch.
financial_benefit: Up to ₹20 Lakhs Collateral-Free Bank Credit with Mudra RuPay Card
ministry: Ministry of Finance
name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Non-corporate small business segment (NCSBS) eligible for micro loans across trading, manufacturing, and services.
Clause 4: No collateral security required; covered under Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU).
summary: Collateral-free institutional bank loans up to ₹20 Lakhs categorized into Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (₹50k to ₹5L), Tarun (₹5L to ₹10L), and Tarun Plus (₹10L to ₹20L) for non-farm income-generating enterprises.
target_beneficiary: Small shopkeepers, kirana owners, street vendors, micro-enterprises, and self-employed units

application_process: Register on standupmitra.in, select preferred bank branch or handholding agency, and submit business DPR.
financial_benefit: ₹10 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore Bank Loan (Composite Term Loan + Working Capital)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
name: Stand-Up India Scheme
rag_clauses: Clause 2: Applicant must be a Woman or belong to SC/ST category starting a greenfield enterprise.
Clause 5: Composite loan covers up to 85% of project cost with margin money convergence.
summary: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one Woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield projects in manufacturing, services, agri-allied or trading sectors.
target_beneficiary: SC, ST, and Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises

application_process: Visit nearest Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch, fill SSY Form-1 with initial deposit of ₹250.
financial_benefit: 8.2% Compound Interest p.a. + Triple Tax Exemption (EEE) + Safe Sovereign Guarantee
ministry: Ministry of Finance
name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Account can be opened in any Post Office or commercial bank branch for a girl child from birth till age 10.
Clause 4: Minimum deposit of Rs 250 and maximum Rs 1,50,000 per financial year with maturity after 21 years.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card / Identity Proof of Guardian
summary: Highest-interest government-backed small savings scheme (8.2% p.a.) with Triple Tax Exemption (Exempt-Exempt-Exempt) under Section 80C to secure higher education and marriage financial corpus of the girl child.
target_beneficiary: Parents and legal guardians of girl children aged 0 to 10 years

application_process: Register on pminternship.mca.gov.in, create profile, browse industry vacancies, and submit applications directly.
financial_benefit: ₹5,000 / month Stipend + ₹6,000 One-time Incidentals Grant + Top 500 Industry Exposure
ministry: Ministry of Corporate Affairs
name: Prime Minister's Internship Scheme 2024-25 (PMIS)
rag_clauses: Clause 3.1: Candidates aged 21-24 not engaged in full-time employment or full-time education with family income <= Rs 8 Lakhs.
Clause 4.1: Direct benefit transfer of Rs 4,500/month by Central Government into Aadhaar-seeded bank account plus Rs 500/month by partner company.
summary: 12-month paid internship in top 500 companies in India offering monthly stipend of ₹5,000 (₹4,500 by Govt + ₹500 by CSR) plus a one-time joining grant of ₹6,000 and full PMJJBY/PMSBY insurance coverage.
target_beneficiary: Youth aged 21-24 with Class 10/12, ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or College Degree

application_process: Enroll on skillindiadigital.gov.in or visit nearest Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK).
financial_benefit: 100% Free NSQF Level 3-6 Skill Certification + Travel/Stipend Grant + Job Placements
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: 100% government-funded training covering Short Term Training (STT) and Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL).
Clause 4: Includes modern courses like AI, Robotics, 3D Printing, Drones, IoT, and Solar PV Installation.
summary: Flagship skill certification scheme offering 100% free industry-aligned technical skill training, NSDC assessment certification, boarding/travel allowances, and direct job placement assistance in Industry 4.0 sectors.
target_beneficiary: School/college dropouts, unemployed youth, and informal sector workers

application_process: Apply on pmfby.gov.in within cut-off date or enroll via bank branch where crop loan (KCC) is maintained.
financial_benefit: Full Sum Insured Value of Crop Loss Claim with Direct Settlement into Bank Account
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
rag_clauses: Clause 2.1: Covers prevented sowing, standing crop damage, localized calamities (hailstorm, landslide), and post-harvest losses.
Clause 5.4: Assessment through satellite remote sensing, weather stations, and crop-cutting experiments.
summary: Comprehensive crop insurance against non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, unseasonal rains, pest attacks) at ultra-low uniform farmer premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops with remaining premium subsidized up to 90% by Government.
target_beneficiary: All farmers growing notified food crops, oilseeds, and commercial horticultural crops

application_process: Fill APY subscriber form at any bank branch or subscribe online through net banking / mobile banking app.
financial_benefit: ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 Guaranteed Monthly Pension for Life + Full Corpus Return to Nominee
ministry: Ministry of Finance
name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Monthly contribution determined based on entry age (e.g., Rs 210/mo at age 18 for Rs 5,000 pension).
Clause 4: Non-taxpayer Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years eligible for enrollment.
required_documents: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Account
summary: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000 or ₹5,000 after age 60, with spouse pension and return of full accumulated pension wealth to nominee.
target_beneficiary: All unorganized sector workers, self-employed, daily wage earners aged 18-40

application_process: Enrollment through Gram Sabha verification and Awaas+ mobile app geo-tagging.
financial_benefit: ₹1,20,000 to ₹1,30,000 Direct Housing Grant + ₹25,000 MGNREGA Wages + ₹12,000 Toilet Grant
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD)
name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Beneficiaries selected based on SECC 2011 / Awas+ verified permanent waitlists.
Clause 3: Funds transferred in 3-4 installments directly to bank account linked to geo-tagged house construction stages.
summary: Direct financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/IAP areas for constructing a 25 sq. meter pucca house with toilet, plus 90 days of MGNREGA wage assistance (~₹25,000) and ₹12,000 Swachh Bharat toilet grant.
target_beneficiary: Houseless rural families and households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses

application_process: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or submit Form-1 at nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas).
financial_benefit: 100% Free LPG Gas Connection + Free First Cylinder & Stove + ₹300/Cylinder DBT Subsidy
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Gas connection issued exclusively in the name of the adult woman member of the household.
Clause 3: Subsidy of Rs 300 per 14.2 kg cylinder credited directly to bank account via PAHAL DBT.
summary: 100% free deposit-free LPG gas connection including first refill and hotplate stove free of cost, plus ongoing direct ₹300 per cylinder DBT subsidy on up to 12 refills per year.
target_beneficiary: Adult women from BPL and poor households lacking LPG connections

application_process: Walk into any bank branch or Bank Mitra kiosk and open PMJDY account with simplified e-KYC.
financial_benefit: Zero Balance Bank Account + ₹2,00,000 Free Accident Insurance + ₹10,000 Overdraft
ministry: Ministry of Finance
name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: No minimum balance required for opening or maintaining PMJDY account.
Clause 3: RuPay card carries Rs 2 Lakh accidental death / permanent disability insurance.
summary: National mission for comprehensive financial inclusion providing zero-balance savings bank accounts, free RuPay debit card with built-in ₹2,00,000 accidental insurance cover, and ₹10,000 overdraft facility.
target_beneficiary: All unbanked adults and rural/urban households across India

application_process: Enrollment verified through Dharani portal records. Contact Village Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO).
financial_benefit: ₹15,000 / acre / year Direct Crop Investment Support
ministry: Agriculture & Farmers Welfare Department, Government of Telangana
name: Telangana Rythu Bharosa / Rythu Bandhu Scheme
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Cash incentive of Rs 7,500 per acre per season disbursed via DBT before every cropping season.
Clause 2: Valid Dharani / RoR passbook is mandatory for verification.
summary: Direct crop investment support of ₹15,000 per acre per year (₹7,500/acre per season for Kharif & Rabi) deposited straight into farmer accounts for purchasing seeds, fertilizers, and inputs.
target_beneficiary: Pattadar farmers, tenant cultivators, and agricultural landholders in Telangana

application_process: Register via District SC Development Officer or Gram Panchayat / Ward Special Officer.
financial_benefit: ₹10,00,000 100% Direct Non-Repayable Capital Grant
ministry: Scheduled Castes Development Department, Government of Telangana
name: Telangana Dalit Bandhu Scheme
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Grant of Rs 10 Lakhs transferred directly into Dalit Bandhu special bank account.
Clause 3: 100% government grant without bank linkage or collateral requirement.
required_documents: Telangana Domicile Proof / Food Security Card
summary: One-time 100% direct financial grant of ₹10,00,000 with zero bank loan and zero repayment obligation, to start business units across transport, manufacturing, retail, or agriculture sectors.
target_beneficiary: Scheduled Caste (SC) families in Telangana seeking enterprise self-employment

application_process: Link Food Security Card and Consumer Number at TSSPDCL/TSNPDCL portal or Praja Palana Seva Kendra.
financial_benefit: Zero Electricity Bill for Monthly Consumption up to 200 Units
ministry: Energy Department, Government of Telangana
name: Telangana Gruha Jyothi Scheme (200 Units Free Electricity)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Full electricity bill waiver for monthly consumption up to 200 units for domestic consumers.
Clause 2: Linked to Praja Palana application and Food Security Card.
summary: 100% free electricity up to 200 units every month for all domestic residential electricity connections holding Food Security Cards / Praja Palana applications.
target_beneficiary: Domestic households and Praja Palana cardholders in Telangana

application_process: For bus travel: Show photo ID to conductor. For ₹2,500 aid: Enroll via Praja Palana Seva Kendra.
financial_benefit: 100% Free Bus Travel + ₹2,500/month Financial Aid + ₹500 Subsidized LPG Cylinder
ministry: Transport and Women Development Department, Government of Telangana
name: Telangana Mahalakshmi Scheme (Free Bus & ₹2,500/Month)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Free zero-fare tickets issued upon showing any government photo ID confirming Telangana domicile.
Clause 2: Direct bank transfer of Rs 2,500/month under Praja Palana guarantee.
summary: 100% free travel in TSRTC Palle Velugu and Express buses across Telangana, along with ₹2,500 per month direct financial assistance to female heads of eligible households and subsidized LPG cylinder for ₹500.
target_beneficiary: All women and transgender residents of Telangana

application_process: Apply at nearest MeeSeva centre or submit Form to Gram Panchayat Secretary / Municipal Ward Officer.
financial_benefit: ₹2,016 to ₹4,016 / month Guaranteed Social Security Pension
ministry: Panchayat Raj & Rural Development Department, Government of Telangana
name: Telangana Aasara Pension Scheme
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Eligibility age for old age pension is 57 years with family income limit of Rs 1.5 Lakhs (rural) and Rs 2 Lakhs (urban).
Clause 3: Divyangjan with 40%+ disability eligible for Rs 4,016 per month.
summary: Monthly social security pension of ₹2,016 per month for elderly, widows, toddy tappers, weavers, and single women, and ₹4,016 per month for persons with disabilities (Divyangjan).
target_beneficiary: Senior citizens (57+), widows, Divyangjan, weavers, and beedi workers in Telangana

application_process: Apply online at telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in / MeeSeva portal at least 15 days before or after marriage.
financial_benefit: ₹1,00,116 One-Time Direct Bank Transfer
ministry: BC Welfare & Minority Welfare Department, Government of Telangana
name: Telangana Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak Scheme
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Bride must have completed 18 years of age and family annual income must not exceed Rs 2,00,000.
Clause 2: Financial assistance of Rs 1,00,116 deposited directly into the bank account of the mother of the bride.
summary: One-time financial marriage assistance of ₹1,00,116 transferred directly into the bank account of the bride's mother at the time of wedding to prevent child marriage and ease economic burden.
target_beneficiary: Unmarried girls from SC, ST, BC, EBC, and Minority families in Telangana

application_process: Apply at Grama One, Karnataka One, Bangalore One centres, or via Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in).
financial_benefit: ₹2,000 / month Direct Bank Transfer (₹24,000/year)
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
name: Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Woman recognized as head of household in BPL/APL/AAY card is entitled to Rs 2,000 monthly DBT.
Clause 2: Woman or her husband must not be an income tax assessee or GST payer.
summary: Direct monthly financial grant of ₹2,000 (₹24,000 per year) credited via DBT into the Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of over 1.2 Crore women heads of households across Karnataka.
target_beneficiary: Woman head of every household (BPL, APL, Antyodaya) in Karnataka

application_process: Register on Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in/gruhajyothi) by entering Account ID and Aadhaar.
financial_benefit: Zero Electricity Bill up to 200 Units per Month
ministry: Energy Department, Government of Karnataka
name: Karnataka Gruha Jyothi Scheme (200 Units Free Electricity)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Covers residential domestic meters with monthly consumption within calculated baseline entitlement (up to 200 units).
Clause 2: Available to tenants and homeowners alike by linking Aadhaar with Consumer Account ID.
required_documents: Electricity Consumer Account ID (BESCOM, HESCOM, GESCOM, MESCOM, CHESCOM)
summary: 100% free electricity up to 200 units monthly calculated based on average annual consumption plus 10% buffer, resulting in zero monthly electricity bills for 1.6+ Crore households.
target_beneficiary: All domestic residential electricity consumers in Karnataka

application_process: Apply online at sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in/Yuvanidhi or through Karnataka One / Grama One centers.
financial_benefit: ₹3,000 / month (Degree) & ₹1,500 / month (Diploma) Direct Benefit Transfer
ministry: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood, Government of Karnataka
name: Karnataka Yuva Nidhi Scheme
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Monthly allowance of Rs 3,000 for unemployed graduates and Rs 1,500 for diploma holders who remain unemployed after 180 days of graduation.
Clause 2: Disbursed for maximum 2 years or until employment is secured.
summary: Direct monthly unemployment financial stipend of ₹3,000 per month for Degree graduates and ₹1,500 per month for Diploma holders for up to 2 years, combined with free skill development training.
target_beneficiary: Unemployed degree and diploma holders who graduated in Karnataka

application_process: Show photo ID to conductor during bus travel to receive zero-fare ticket or apply for Shakti Smart Card on Seva Sindhu.
financial_benefit: 100% Free Public Bus Travel across Karnataka
ministry: Transport Department, Government of Karnataka
name: Karnataka Shakti Scheme (Free Bus Travel for Women)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Free travel in non-luxury state road transport corporation buses across Karnataka upon presenting government-issued photo ID.
Clause 2: Applicable across ordinary, express, and town services.
required_documents: Government Photo ID showing Karnataka address (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Driving License)
summary: 100% free bus travel for all women across Karnataka in ordinary, express, and city buses run by KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, and KKRTC.
target_beneficiary: All women and girl students domiciled in Karnataka

application_process: Apply online at ladkibahin.maharashtra.gov.in / Nari Shakti Doot App or visit nearest Anganwadi / Setu Suvidha Kendra.
financial_benefit: ₹1,500 / month Direct Benefit Transfer (₹18,000/year)
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
name: Maharashtra Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Monthly cash transfer of Rs 1,500 into personal Aadhaar-seeded bank account for women with family income up to Rs 2.5 Lakhs.
Clause 2: Yellow or Orange ration card holders exempted from separate income certificate requirement.
summary: Flagship direct benefit cash transfer scheme providing ₹1,500 per month (₹18,000 per year) deposited directly into the bank accounts of over 2.4 Crore women across Maharashtra for health, nutrition, and self-reliance.
target_beneficiary: Women aged 21 to 65 years from low-income families in Maharashtra

application_process: Automatic enrollment for all verified PM-KISAN beneficiaries in Maharashtra. Check status on MahaDBT portal.
financial_benefit: ₹6,000 / year State Direct Benefit Transfer (Total ₹12,000/yr with PM-KISAN)
ministry: Agriculture Department, Government of Maharashtra
name: Maharashtra Namo Shetkari Maha Samman Nidhi Yojana
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Direct payment of Rs 2,000 every 4 months to all eligible PM-KISAN landholder farmers in Maharashtra.
Clause 2: Automatic integration with Mahabhulekh land record system and e-KYC.
summary: State top-up financial grant of ₹6,000 per year in three installments of ₹2,000 each, disbursed in addition to PM-KISAN (providing a total of ₹12,000 per year to farmers in Maharashtra).
target_beneficiary: All landholding farmers registered under PM-KISAN in Maharashtra

application_process: Visit Arogyamitra help desk at any empanelled hospital with Ration Card and Aadhaar Card for instant cashless admission.
financial_benefit: ₹5,00,000 / year Cashless Hospitalization Treatment Cover
ministry: Public Health Department, Government of Maharashtra
name: Maharashtra Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Cashless medical treatment up to Rs 5 Lakhs per family per annum across private and government empanelled hospitals.
Clause 2: All Yellow, Orange, and White ration card holders in Maharashtra eligible.
summary: Universal cashless healthcare scheme providing ₹5,00,000 hospitalization and surgery coverage per family per year covering 1,356 medical and surgical procedures across 1,000+ empanelled hospitals.
target_beneficiary: All ration card holding families across Maharashtra (Universal Coverage)

application_process: Register via special camp at Fair Price Shops (Ration Shops) or submit appeal through e-Sevai centres (tnesevai.tn.gov.in).
financial_benefit: ₹1,000 / month Direct Bank Transfer (₹12,000/year)
ministry: Special Programme Implementation Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
name: Tamil Nadu Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Scheme (KMUT)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Monthly basic income grant of Rs 1,000 to woman recognized as head of family in Smart Ration Card.
Clause 2: Household annual income <= Rs 2.5 Lakhs, annual domestic electricity consumption < 3600 units, and wetland holding < 5 acres.
summary: Landmark basic income entitlement scheme providing ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000 per year) directly credited on the 15th of every month to over 1.15 Crore women heads of families across Tamil Nadu.
target_beneficiary: Women heads of low-income and working-class households in Tamil Nadu

application_process: College Nodal Officers verify and enroll eligible students via www.tn.gov.in portal.
financial_benefit: ₹1,000 / month Higher Education Incentive (₹12,000/year)
ministry: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
name: Tamil Nadu Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Scheme)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Financial incentive of Rs 1,000 per month credited directly until graduation / diploma completion.
Clause 2: Student must have completed Class 6 to Class 12 continuously in Tamil Nadu government schools.
summary: Direct monthly cash incentive of ₹1,000 per month deposited into girl students' bank accounts throughout the duration of their Undergraduate Degree, Diploma, ITI, or Professional course.
target_beneficiary: Girl students who studied Class 6 to 12 in Government schools pursuing higher education

application_process: Enroll at District Collectorate CMCHIS kiosk or present Smart Card at empanelled hospital helpdesk.
financial_benefit: ₹5,00,000 / year Cashless Hospitalization Coverage
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
name: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Cashless medical treatment cover of Rs 5 Lakhs per annum per family.
Clause 2: Smart Card issued to eligible families with annual income <= Rs 1,20,000.
required_documents: Income Certificate from Village Administrative Officer (VAO)
summary: Cashless hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for 1,500+ medical and surgical procedures across top empanelled government and private hospitals in Tamil Nadu.
target_beneficiary: Low-income families with annual income below ₹1,20,000 in Tamil Nadu

application_process: Apply online at mksy.up.gov.in or through nearest Jan Seva Kendra / CSC.
financial_benefit: ₹25,000 Total Direct Financial Grant in 6 Milestone Stages
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Upgraded financial assistance of Rs 25,000 across 6 stages (Birth Rs 5k, Vaccines Rs 2k, Class 1 Rs 3k, Class 6 Rs 3k, Class 9 Rs 5k, Degree/Diploma Rs 7k).
Clause 2: Maximum 2 daughters per family eligible with family income limit of Rs 3,00,000.
summary: Total conditional cash financial grant of ₹25,000 released in 6 milestone stages from birth, full immunization, Class 1 admission, Class 6 admission, Class 9 admission, to passing Class 12 and entering Degree/Diploma.
target_beneficiary: Girl children born in Uttar Pradesh from low-income families

application_process: Register online at edistrict.up.gov.in and appear in annual online entrance examination.
financial_benefit: 100% Free Elite Competitive Coaching + Free Digital Tablet Allowance
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Free Coaching Scheme
rag_clauses: Clause 1: Free offline center coaching in every divisional headquarters and online lectures across UP.
Clause 3: Free tablet distribution to top performing students selected through state eligibility test.
summary: 100% free high-quality classroom and online coaching for UPSC Civil Services, UPPSC, JEE, NEET, NDA, CDS, and Banking exams conducted by IAS/IPS/PCS officers and subject experts, along with free tablet assistance.
